# 📱 iOS x Android ### Bring iOS Emoji & Kohinoor Bangla font to your rooted Android device — system-wide.

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/VERSION-o.1-blue?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=1a1a1a) ![Author](https://img.shields.io/badge/AUTHOR-SABBIR_SENPAI-purple?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=1a1a1a) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/PLATFORM-MAGISK_|_KERNELSU_|_APATCH-red?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=1a1a1a) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/LICENSE-MIT-green?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=1a1a1a)
--- ## ✨ Features - 🍎 **iOS Emoji** → System-wide replace on all apps - 🔤 **Kohinoor Bangla Font** → Applied to system & all apps - 🎨 **Beautiful Flashing UI** → Styled terminal output - 🧹 **Auto Cache Cleanup** → On install & uninstall - ⚡ **Lightweight** → Zero bloat, zero background service - 🛡️ **Safe & Reversible** → Disable module & reboot to restore - 🔒 **GMS Font Blocked** → Google can't override your emoji - 🔄 **Auto Update** → Via module manager - 🔧 **Compatible** → Magisk / KernelSU / KernelSU Next / SukiSU / APatch --- ## 📲 Supported Root Managers | Manager | Support | |---------|:-------:| | Magisk | ✅ | | Magisk Delta | ✅ | | Magisk Alpha | ✅ | | KitsuneMagisk | ✅ | | KernelSU | ✅ | | KernelSU Next | ✅ | | SukiSU | ✅ | | SukiSU Ultra | ✅ | | APatch | ✅ | | Cherish PeekABoo | ✅ | --- ## 🛠️ Installation 1. **Download** the latest `iOSx69.zip` from [**Releases**](../../releases/latest) 2. **Open** your module manager (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch) 3. **Go to** Modules → Install from storage 4. **Select** the ZIP file 5. **Reboot** your device > 📌 **Note:** After first boot, wait 30–60 seconds for emoji & font changes to fully apply. --- ## 🔄 Update The module supports **automatic updates** via the module manager. When a new version is released, you'll see an **Update Available** notification — just tap **Update**. --- ## 🗑️ Uninstall 1. Open your module manager 2. Go to **Modules** 3. Find **iOSxAndroid** → tap **Remove** 4. **Reboot** your device All changes (emoji, font, caches, GMS font services) will be **automatically restored**. --- ## ⚠️ Known Limitations - **WhatsApp, Twitter/X, Discord, Snapchat** → These apps bundle emoji inside the APK. Module can't change them. - **Instagram Story reply picker** → May crash on some ROMs. If it does, remove `com.instagram.android` from the script and reinstall. --- ## 🧪 Requirements - Android **10 or higher** - **Magisk / KernelSU / APatch** installed - **~30 MB** free storage --- ## 📖 Changelog See [**CHANGES**](changelog.md) for full version history. --- ## 👤 Credits **by Sabbir Senpai** 😈🤟 --- ## 📜 License **MIT License** — feel free to fork, modify & share. ---

📱 iOS x Android

Bring iOS Emoji & Kohinoor Bangla font to your rooted Android device — system-wide.


!Version

!Author

!Platform

!License

---

✨ Features

  • 🍎 **iOS Emoji** → System-wide replace on all apps
  • 🔤 **Kohinoor Bangla Font** → Applied to system & all apps
  • 🎨 **Beautiful Flashing UI** → Styled terminal output
  • 🧹 **Auto Cache Cleanup** → On install & uninstall
  • ⚡ **Lightweight** → Zero bloat, zero background service
  • 🛡️ **Safe & Reversible** → Disable module & reboot to restore
  • 🔒 **GMS Font Blocked** → Google can't override your emoji
  • 🔄 **Auto Update** → Via module manager
  • 🔧 **Compatible** → Magisk / KernelSU / KernelSU Next / SukiSU / APatch

    • ---

    📲 Supported Root Managers

    | Manager | Support |

    |---------|:-------:|

    | Magisk | ✅ |

    | Magisk Delta | ✅ |

    | Magisk Alpha | ✅ |

    | KitsuneMagisk | ✅ |

    | KernelSU | ✅ |

    | KernelSU Next | ✅ |

    | SukiSU | ✅ |

    | SukiSU Ultra | ✅ |

    | APatch | ✅ |

    | Cherish PeekABoo | ✅ |

    ---

    🛠️ Installation

  • **Download** the latest `iOSx69.zip` from [**Releases**](../../releases/latest)
  • **Open** your module manager (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch)
  • **Go to** Modules → Install from storage
  • **Select** the ZIP file
  • **Reboot** your device

    • > 📌 Note: After first boot, wait 30–60 seconds for emoji & font changes to fully apply.

    ---

    🔄 Update

    The module supports automatic updates via the module manager. When a new version is released, you'll see an Update Available notification — just tap Update.

    ---

    🗑️ Uninstall

  • Open your module manager
  • Go to **Modules**
  • Find **iOSxAndroid** → tap **Remove**
  • **Reboot** your device

    • All changes (emoji, font, caches, GMS font services) will be automatically restored.

    ---

    ⚠️ Known Limitations

  • **WhatsApp, Twitter/X, Discord, Snapchat** → These apps bundle emoji inside the APK. Module can't change them.
  • **Instagram Story reply picker** → May crash on some ROMs. If it does, remove `com.instagram.android` from the script and reinstall.

    • ---

    🧪 Requirements

  • Android **10 or higher**
  • **Magisk / KernelSU / APatch** installed
  • **~30 MB** free storage

    • ---

    📖 Changelog

    See CHANGES for full version history.
